title: Dashboard Scaffold — Vite + React + Tailwind + shadcn
description:
Dashboard Scaffold — Vite + React + Tailwind + shadcn
- Create src/dashboard/ sub-project from scratch
- src/dashboard/package.json:
  - name: "deckent-dashboard", private: true, type: "module"
  - dependencies: react@^19, react-dom@^19, react-router-dom@^7, recharts@^2, lucide-react, class-variance-authority, clsx, tailwind-merge
  - devDependencies: @types/react, @types/react-dom, typescript, vite@^6, @vitejs/plugin-react, tailwindcss@^4, @tailwindcss/vite
  - scripts: dev ("vite"), build ("tsc -b && vite build"), preview ("vite preview")
- src/dashboard/vite.config.ts: @vitejs/plugin-react + @tailwindcss/vite plugins, server.port 5173, server.proxy /api → http://localhost:3100
- src/dashboard/tsconfig.json: target ES2022, module ESNext, moduleResolution bundler, jsx react-jsx, lib [ES2022, DOM, DOM.Iterable], strict, paths @/* → src/*
- src/dashboard/tsconfig.node.json: for vite.config.ts (module NodeNext, include vite.config.ts)
- src/dashboard/index.html: standard Vite entry with <div id="root"> and <script type="module" src="/src/main.tsx">
- src/dashboard/src/main.tsx: createRoot + <App />
- src/dashboard/src/App.tsx: BrowserRouter + Routes with lazy-loaded page placeholders for /, /settings, /history, /memory
- src/dashboard/src/index.css: @import "tailwindcss", dark theme CSS variables (@theme block with zinc palette)
- src/dashboard/src/lib/utils.ts: export cn() function (clsx + tailwind-merge)
- src/dashboard/src/lib/api.ts: fetchJson(url), postJson(url, body) typed wrappers with error handling
- src/dashboard/src/hooks/useSSE.ts: custom hook connecting to /api/events, returns DashboardState | null, auto-reconnect on error (3s delay)
- src/dashboard/src/hooks/useApi.ts: generic useFetch<T>(url) hook with loading/error/data states + refetch()
- src/dashboard/src/types/index.ts: DashboardState, AgentInfo, Alert, SprintMetrics, DeckentConfig type mirrors (subset of core/types.ts, standalone — NO import from main project)
- src/dashboard/src/components/ui/button.tsx: shadcn Button component (variant: default, destructive, outline, ghost)
- src/dashboard/src/components/ui/card.tsx: shadcn Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardContent, CardDescription
- Placeholder pages: src/dashboard/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx, SettingsPage.tsx, HistoryPage.tsx, MemoryPage.tsx — each exports default function with minimal content
- Run: cd src/dashboard && npm install
- Dosya: src/dashboard/package.json, src/dashboard/vite.config.ts, src/dashboard/tsconfig.json, src/dashboard/tsconfig.node.json, src/dashboard/index.html, src/dashboard/src/main.tsx, src/dashboard/src/App.tsx, src/dashboard/src/index.css, src/dashboard/src/lib/utils.ts, src/dashboard/src/lib/api.ts, src/dashboard/src/hooks/useSSE.ts, src/dashboard/src/hooks/useApi.ts, src/dashboard/src/types/index.ts, src/dashboard/src/components/ui/button.tsx, src/dashboard/src/components/ui/card.tsx, src/dashboard/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx, src/dashboard/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx, src/dashboard/src/pages/HistoryPage.tsx, src/dashboard/src/pages/MemoryPage.tsx
- Kapsam: src/dashboard/
